title: Understanding God’s Priority and Primary Interest Part 1
paragraphs: Please write this topic in your notes on a clean sheet of paper: Rediscovering God's priorities. The Kingdom first. We will look at understanding God's priorities and primary concerns. What is God's primary concern? What is his first priority? A few weeks ago, I secluded myself, distanced myself from everyone, and spent 15 days at home praying and fasting. I removed the food from myself and sought the Lord.

And I had, and listen carefully, I wanted to know: O God, what is your first concern for your people and for the world? I want to know that because I am required all over the world to speak on behalf of God. It is important never to speak on behalf of someone who has not spoken to you. Therefore, I always make it a priority in my life, at the end of the year, to draw closer to and delve deeper into the mind of God, in order to understand His will.

During those fifteen days, without food and with quiet, private time with the Lord, the Lord spoke to me. Now, when you've been isolated for 15 days and haven't eaten anything, you think God is going to talk to you in a long sentence. But when the Lord speaks, his most profound words come in short sentences. All he said to me when I asked him, "What do you want? What is your first concern for the church, for the world, and for planet Earth?" His answer was two words. He said: "The Kingdom comes first." That's all.

I waited and waited and waited, and this is all I got. He said: "The Kingdom comes first." I had to go back, as always, because God would never say anything that wasn't in the Bible. And there it was, clearly visible to me. Matthew, chapter 6, verse 33, which is the passage that explains everything. Jesus explains what God's priorities are and what his priority is as Lord and Savior of mankind. But what I found interesting was that he did not say that this was a priority only for believers.

He said: "This is the priority for the entire world." For every human being. That was interesting to me because I thought this would be something only we were told. But he said that this is a requirement for every human being. Order first. Everyone should say: "First". Firstly. Say it again, "First". Two years ago, I read a book. About 5 years ago, I read a book. One of the books I had to read that month was by Stephen Covey. Some of you have read his books.

His best-selling book is titled "The 7 Habits of Highly Effective People". How many of you have read that book? good. It's good to see that some of you have read it. It's a good book. I encourage you to read that book. Actually, I read it twice. After reading the book, I was very impressed with its content. He then wrote a second book immediately afterward, which also became a bestseller. When I saw it, I automatically took it and bought it. The title of that book was "First things first".

Stephen Covey wrote that book. How many of you have read that book? Has anyone read it? One, two. Oh God, please help me. Good. May I suggest... three? Can I recommend that you go to libraries and read? It's a good book. "First things first." I have read the book. Actually, I read the book in two sittings because I am good at speed reading. I was impressed by it because in that book he talks about why successful people succeed and why they live at a higher standard in life.

The reason is that they live according to priorities. Then he talks about choosing your life priorities so that you don't waste your time doing things that won't get you where you want to be. In that book, he talks about the priority of family, the priority of self-discipline, and the priority of diet. You know, those are very good principles. When I read the book, I liked it, but I wasn't surprised because everything it said should be done in the book, I was already doing. It's a good book.

However, when someone greater than Stephen Covey spoke to me, he showed me that Stephen Covey, although he wrote an excellent treatise on priorities entitled "First Things First, " did not include the most important priority. It is God's priority. What is God's priority? What is her role in your life? I want you to write these things down. First, let me begin by telling you what I have discovered during the past 51 years of my life as " keys to life". Everyone wants to know what the keys to life are.

Here's the first key, and this is one of my most famous statements, but I want to say it again. The greatest tragedy in life is not death. There is something worse than death. The greatest tragedy in life is to live a life without purpose. In other words, living without knowing the reason is more tragic than dying without knowing life. It's tragic. So, one of the keys to life is discovering a purpose or reason for your existence. Secondly, the biggest challenge in life is knowing what to do.

Knowing what needs to be done. It is a challenge to try to figure out what to do each day. And what should you do with your hours and your time? Waking up in the morning, getting in the car, getting stuck in traffic, and going to the same place every Monday morning. Being preoccupied with everything you do. Is this what you're supposed to do? That is the question. What are you and we supposed to do? Key number three. Biggest mistake, please write this in capital letters.

In life, it's about being busy but not being productive. It is a mistake to be busy but not to be effective. Everyone in this room and everyone watching this program around the world, you are busy. Young people are busy. The adults are busy. Older people are busy. Everyone is doing things. The question is: Are you effective? And how do you know the difference between being busy and being effective? We will find out in the next few sessions. Key number four.

The biggest failure in life is succeeding at the wrong task. Please write this down. The biggest failure in life is succeeding at the wrong task. Nothing is more frustrating than doing an excellent job at something you weren't supposed to do. It's like getting an A on the wrong test. Failure is not always the inability to do something. Failure may be the result of hard work and doing an excellent job if, after you finish, it turns out to have been the wrong task. Therefore, success has little to do with hard work.

Did you know? The thief works hard. He has to spread those bars over the window. He is sweating profusely. Then he has to climb and hurt himself to get in through the window. Hard work, man. Then he has to fall when he enters to reach the room. Then he has to try to pass the television through the opening. Hard work, man. He falls outside and hurts his knee. Do you think it's successful? He works hard. The prostitute works hard. When you go to sleep, she starts her work. It is passed from hand to hand.

She is subjected to insults and slaps. Hard work. As you can see, hard work does not mean you are successful. So, the biggest failure in life is succeeding at the wrong task. It couldn't get any worse. So, one way you need to protect yourself from failure is to deal with the issue of prioritizing. Priorities come first. Everyone should prioritize first. Please write this down. Success in life is the effective use of time. Success in life is the result of making effective use of time.

You are now exactly what you traded your time for. That's all you are. Therefore, everyone in this room is a result of the same thing. How we use our time. If you spend your time sitting on the couch eating all the time, you will most likely find that you are fat, overweight, and unfit. If you don't exercise regularly, you will reach a certain state. This leads us to number two. Time is the true measure of life. It took me a long time to realize that. Life is simply time.

When you tell me you are 50 years old, you are telling me what you have done during your 50 years of life. So, you measure your life by what you do with time. This leads us to number three. This is very important, write this down. Time is the currency of life. Say it with me. Time is the currency. What is the currency? Currency is the medium of exchange that you use to buy things. Please listen carefully. So, the currency in life is time. You use time to buy life.

Anything you own in life, you have bought with your time. Whatever condition you are in, and whatever you lack or possess, is a result of what you have used your time to acquire. That's why they pay you for your time. This is called a job. This leads me to number four. This is more dangerous. How we spend our time determines the quality of our lives and our deaths. How we spend our time determines the quality of our lives and our deaths. Your time determines how you die and how you live.

As you know, I am now whatever I have exchanged my time for. If you are broke, it is because this is what you bought with your time. If you are rich, it is because this is what you bought with your time. If you are overweight, you may have used the currency of time to buy it. If you spend your time watching 5 hours of television instead of reading your Bible, now you understand why you are spiritually weak. Can I say a phrase you should never forget?

Every morning, everyone starts life with the same amount of money. 24 hours. At the end of the day, everyone is different from each other because of the way they used their currency during the twenty-four hours. If you are smart and wise, it is clear that you have spent some time reading books, listening to good tapes, or studying somewhere, because you don't just wake up smart all of a sudden. And if you are stupid, foolish, and ignorant, you have bought that for yourself.

And I paid the price for that with the time I spent sitting and watching five consecutive HBO movies filled with profanity. That's all it represents. Whatever you trade with your time, you become its currency. You buy life with time. So, if you want to change the quality of your life, you need to change how you spend your money. the time. Does this make sense? Good. So, point five is the most challenging. Everything and everyone covets your time. Now, it's the only currency she has, and everyone is after her.

And everything is chasing her. If I could emphasize one thing to you, my friend, it would be this. Protect your currency. There are some people who seek to waste your currency. They want to spend time. Let everyone say: Spending. See, I told you it's currency. However you spend it, everyone should say: spending. However you spend your time, you buy with it everything you spend it on. If you spend your time with a fool, you are buying foolishness. People are after your time.

You know, the older I get, the less money I have to waste. Does anyone know what I'm talking about? When you reach forty and fifty, you no longer want to mess around. Don't mess with me. Can I hear "Amen" from someone close to you somewhere? Look, because some people just want to drain your currency. Choose your friends carefully. Because many of them will lose your currency. So, everything is after your time. That's why I said this in the first service and I'll say it again.

The hardest button you can press in your life is the stop button on the remote control. I'm right, aren't I? You sit in that house, and you don't even want to go to the bathroom. You can't stop. Because they keep bombarding you with advertisements and dramas, and they tell you that you can now switch between channels. They don't want you to leave. They... they just want everything to steal your time. You can sit and watch TV until you urinate on yourself. Because you can't go to the bathroom.

Because you don't want to miss anything. Look, they're after your time. I am afraid of cable television. Personally, I fear him because he is a thief. You know, thieves steal currency. That's a big thief. There are people who sit for seven hours and are exploited by a thief called the Cable. They are not wiser. They are not more cunning. And they are not more intelligent. They did not grow spiritually, nor did they grow intellectually. And when it's over, the only winner is the advertiser. Spend your currency.

I want you to practice pressing the stop button. Go home and try it a few times. Just turn it on, one click. Count to five and press it, click. Restart it, click. Count five times and press it, click. Just train. Practice the feeling of being extinguished. They have psychologically proven that whenever you press the stop button on the remote control, a release occurs in your physical body. Get rid of the stress. What do you spend your time on? They are after him. Why am I stuck here?

Some of you are about to connect this year with people who are time thieves. Be careful. They come to hinder you. Let me tell you something about time thieves. Time can be stolen not only by bad things, but also by good things. You can spend—everyone says spend—your time doing good things, but they are not right for you. So, don't just assume that bad is bad. Often, good is bad. In fact, most of the good time is bad. It took me years to realize that. How many of you have a task and keep avoiding it?

She avoids it by doing less important but good things. Because you don't want to start with the complex main task. So she keeps procrastinating and says every day, "I'll do it tomorrow. I'll do it tomorrow." The things you are doing instead are good things, but you are not doing the right thing. So, you are wasting money. Write this down. This is the most important point. The key to effective time use is having the right priorities. The key to effective time management, my son, is finding the right priorities.

Everyone says it's a correct priority. You know, the Holy Spirit told me: "Priority is not enough." Because you can create priorities that are not correct. In other words, I have a priority to drink coffee every morning. Well, maybe that's not good for you. My priority is to smoke my cigarette every morning. Okay, that's a priority, but is it a good priority? Having a large meal at 10 pm every night is a priority. Is this a good priority? It's no wonder your body is always tired.

Because it digests food while you are asleep. Look, priorities alone are not enough. So, what we need to learn in this series about the Kingdom is what God’s right priority is. First things first, then the important ones. Say that with me. First things first, then the important ones. First things first, then the important ones. I think I'll end up writing a book on this subject. It will be the other book that Stephen Covey has not written.

Steve, you might be watching this show, and I want you to know that I appreciate you. As you know, we've spoken a few times in similar circles, so I understand him very well. But I will write a book entitled "First of all". Because what we need to do is correct what people have been consuming as a solution to their problems. The solution to their problem is not what he offered them, although what he offered them was good. According to Jesus, it is not the right priority. This is extremely important.

So, what is the key to using your time effectively? What is it? The correct priority. The correct priority. Not just a priority, but a proper priority. Okay, let's talk about the priority of priorities. Why is priority a priority? Firstly, priority is priority because being preoccupied with priorities preserves and protects life. When you set the right priorities in your life, it actually protects your life. Tell me why. Because it protects your time.

You don't waste your time doing things you shouldn't do when you set the right priorities in your life. May I suggest to you that every morning you wake up, there are a million things you can do that day. Am I right? Therefore, it is best to know, by some miracle, which of those alternatives you should do on that day. Some days I feel frustrated, a few of them, but there are those few days when I haven't accomplished what I planned. This makes me angry. Sometimes the reason is that people interfered in my day.

They came without prior warning. Oh Jesus. Let me tell you something. One of the worst curses in life is people who visit you unexpectedly. Does anyone have any unexpected visitors? I'm just visiting to check on you. Don't visit me suddenly. Don't surprise me with a visit. Good? Because you see, the older you get, the less time you have for surprise visits. Is there anyone there to help me, or am I alone here? Look, you do n't have time. You see, my life is very precise.

For every hour of my life, I make a complete plan. Even my rest is planned. So, you come along and think I'm not doing anything. I have rested. You don't need to come here. It's planned. Extremely important. Therefore, you and I must realize that when you prioritize, you protect your life. It keeps you alive. Taking care of things is important, isn't it? Do you know why we all feel tired? Because people drain our energy. Oh, I'm talking about myself. People come to you and keep bringing negativity, negative things.

They bring all their problems. I mean, 10 people in one day and nine of them came with a problem. Now all those problems are in your head. So, you are now drained. They don't protect your life. They are destroying it. That is why Jesus Christ was running away. The Bible says he was running away alone. He even hid from the students. Many times he says that he stepped aside on his own. He didn't even want Peter around. He talked a lot. There comes a time when you must be very careful with your time.

And the older you get, the worse it gets. Am I right about that? You start to wonder, do these people have nothing better to do than annoy me? I have things to do in life. How many of you have things to do in life? Come on, teenagers. You have things, and you have to be careful because there are people who do not respect your currency. They destroy it. Secondly, the correct priority is the principle of progress. Please note that. It is extremely important.

When the Holy Spirit told me this, I was almost shocked because I thought I had figured it out until He told me. He said, "Look." He said, "You don't know progress unless you know priorities." Progress is the result of moving in the direction in which you were supposed to move, which means that movement does not guarantee progress. I was telling this story in my early service. I got lost in Florida. Has anyone gotten lost while driving in Florida? Yes, I got lost in Florida.

I got lost in Florida years ago when I started driving there and missed the exit. I did n't understand it. And I ended up near Tallahassee. Lord Jesus. I drove for hours. I said to myself, there is something wrong here and I don't know what it is. I saw the sign, Tallahassee, 300 miles. I said, " Guy, I must have gone halfway in Florida." Now, watch this. I was moving. I was walking along the road. The road was good. It was paved. The signs were beautiful. All the exits were marked and I was moving.

But I was getting further and further away from my destination. Look, I'm not impressed by your work if it's wrong. I am not impressed by your business if it is taking you to the wrong destination. Don't envy busy people because you don't know where they go. Go ahead, watch me now. Say Amen. Jesus said to the Pharisees, “He says that you are always learning but never attaining knowledge of the truth.” Going to school does not make you smart. That's what he's talking about. What are you getting a certificate in?

Boy, I tell you, you must, let everyone say: the right priorities. Look, there were many exits along the road where I was driving, but none of them were the right one. Were the exits bad? No, they were all good. But was it true? Not for me. Look, good is not always true. I'm hinting at something you'll realize next week. Don't miss next week, okay? But I lay the foundation here. Look, one of the biggest problems in the world is, please, listen to me. Lord, help me.

The number one problem in the Christian world is me. I'm talking about 2000 years of history. We were busy. I went to college. I obtained a degree in theology. I keep repeating this because I think, look, let me tell you something. When you realize that you've been doing the wrong thing for a long time, you get angry, you know? Come on, be honest now. Do you remember when you first discovered that what you were doing was wrong? Do you remember how you felt? At first, I felt angry at myself because I was so stupid.

Then, you became angry at the person who made you believe it was true. This is what happened to me spiritually. So, I went to college and got a degree. Thank you, my son. May the Prophet's reward be upon you. I obtained a degree in theology. Listen carefully, young people, because some of you go to Bible schools. I don't want you to waste your time. I went to a theological seminary. I obtained a degree in theology. They made me read to everyone. All theological theories. All these different theological thinkers.

One of the most important people who made me read was Saint Augustine. Because they say he is the father of modern theology. Saint Augustine was a Catholic priest. This took place in a spiritually immersed evangelical theological seminary. They made sure that I memorized the teachings of Saint Augustine. There was not a single portion, not even one, about the Kingdom of God. I graduated with a degree in theology. Theology. Come on, guys, look at me. Theology. "Theo" means God. "Logia" means study or knowledge.

Theology means knowing God. So, I received a certificate in knowing God, and they didn't give me a single lesson on the one thing Jesus preached. What do I want to say? They set some priorities for me, but they weren't the right priorities. I was born in the Bahamas. When I was born, I was certain that when my mother took me out of her womb, I had landed in a church pew. Throughout my life, my father and mother were in church service. I landed in a church pew. So, I went through all those experiences.

I was in the Brethren Church. Then we moved from there to the Baptist Church. Oh, and the best Baptist church at that time, too. Bethel Baptist Church. Its sponsor, thank God, is H. W. Brown. I mean, we stayed there for years. Then we moved, as you know, to the Pentecostal Church, the Evangelical Center. I used to play the piano in all these churches. A young boy, you know, involved in everything. From there we went to the Assemblies of God. We went to God's church.

Ladies and gentlemen, there was not a single sermon about the Kingdom. It is the only thing that Jesus preached. They preached about everything, but no one preached about the kingdom. Matthew 6:33. May I say it? Ask, don't read it quickly, first. Say " first" out loud. Firstly. Say it again. Firstly. He said, "Look, whatever you ask for, do not ask for salvation, do not ask for faith, do not ask for baptism of the Spirit, do not ask for charity, do not ask for prosperity. He says the first priority is the Kingdom."

How come they never told me that? Why? Because they graduated from schools like the ones I graduated from. You can only teach what you know. You can only pass on what you have learned. Ladies and gentlemen, listen to me. Listen to me. This is strange, Shepherd Richard. My secretary will show you hundreds of emails and letters.

In fact, I am going through a struggle in my personal life right now, because these messages are from people all over the world who have heard a tape or CD, or watched a program, or read my book about the Kingdom. They all ask: "Is the school open?" They tell you which school they want. "We want to come to learn about the Kingdom." These messages are from bishops, pastors, elders, and deacons. These are professors of theology. Why? Because they realized they didn't even know where to go to get this information.

This makes me feel scared. Could what we are doing here be that important? My question is, has the church progressed since Jesus left the earth in the Book of Acts, chapter one? The answer is sad. Can I show you something you won't believe? Okay, you won't believe him, agreed? Bring your Bibles, I'll show you something. Open to the Book of Acts, Chapter 1. I just want to show you this. We can address this in the next two weeks. I'll use my copy, that's fine. The Book of Acts, Chapter 1. Is everyone here?

Are you learning anything this morning? Okay, it won't take long, but listen to this. The Book of Acts, Chapter 1. I want you to read this again. Jesus, after the resurrection, had only one thing on his mind. Now, I want you to read this for yourselves. Good? Look in the Bible, because if you do not read this yourselves, you will not believe that it is in the Bible. The Book of Acts, Chapter 1. He has risen from the dead. He is about to leave Earth, and this is his last meeting on Earth. His last meeting.

This is what he says in the Book of Acts, Chapter 1. The first verse. In the first book, by the way, Luke is the one who writes this, okay? Luke was a physician. He was a doctor. In the first book, Theophilus, I wrote about everything that Jesus began to do and teach. The second verse. Until the day he ascended to heaven. After the Holy Spirit recommended the apostles whom he had chosen. Then he left. Now, what are the commandments? Look at the third verse.

After his sufferings, which means his death on the cross, I show himself to these men with many proofs that he is alive. Continue reading. He appeared to them over a period of forty days. What was he doing? In those days, he spoke to them about one subject. That's all for now. The religious institute never mentioned that, not even once. He preached it throughout his thirty-three and a half years of life. He went to hell, got up again, and began to preach it again. Why? Because it is God's highest priority.

And now, look, a dead man is preaching. You know that it is better to preach it. Not just a living man, but one who died and came back to life. He said, "Look, I'll let us speak." Now, if you read the next few verses, you will see some problems, because the disciples have not yet grasped the matter. They thought he came to establish a national government for a small group of people called Israel. He had to reprimand them. He said: "I came to restore the Kingdom of God to the whole world.

Not to a group of people, and this is not a national message. This is a universal message." He had to reprimand them. We are still overlooking that. Have we made any progress? Look, progress, follow me now. Does anyone understand this? I feel a spiritual touch, boy, I tell you. You can feel it, you don't want to move. Listen, don't make a mistake. Progress is measured by the task. Not active. So, if I tell you, can I tell you what he told us? Read Matthew 24:14.

He says: “ This gospel is not what you like to preach. When this gospel of the kingdom is preached throughout the world, it will be a testimony to all nations.” He said, "When you do that, then the end will come." I wonder why he hasn't come yet. He is not coming because Bin Laden is there. It does not come about because of a tsunami or an earthquake. It is not caused by a hurricane hitting New Orleans or Freeport. Stop with the nonsense. He said, "I will come when my people are preaching the right message."

What is that message? The Kingdom. And now, progress, huh? How are we? And now, how are we doing in this world? I don't know about my life. I have lived a short time on Earth so far, 50 years, and I have heard that once. I do n't know which church I came from. I don't know where to go to the church. I don't know anything about you. But I challenge you to tell me, did your shepherd preach the Kingdom? Every time you went there, every day? I don't know about myself.

Look, this is a serious question because you just read the assignment. I always say: "Priorities come first." Write this down. Prioritizing correctly protects your time. That's point three. Having the right priorities protects you from wasting your time. Good. Listen. I want you to attend meetings with me at some point, is that understood? I want you to sit in the room, as I have brought along some of the mentors he has been dealing with with me.

At a meeting I attended last week, I was in a meeting during the past few days with some senior figures that you know. I mean the VIPs you see on TV every day. We were at a small meeting in Dallas, Texas a few days ago, and it was a planning meeting to talk about what's happening in the church. I sat there and everyone you know was there. And here I am, the only person sitting there from this part of the world.

They were talking about the church in America, in the Western world, in Europe, and all these profound matters, and they went into all sorts of topics. They began to discuss who was a messenger, who was not a messenger, who was a prophet, and who deserved to be a bishop, and I sat there in silence. I said to myself, "I will not interfere in this." I said, "That's not the point." In the end, they realized that I had been silent. And... as you know, said the president, and Jack Hayford was the president.

He said, "Dr. Monroe, you have 5 minutes." "Please tell us what's on your mind." I hesitated for a long time because I said, "This will not be nice." And I simply reminded them... of the matter of the Kingdom. And... a big discussion followed. The course of the discussion changed. And I sat there. Look, let me tell you. It is very difficult for you, very difficult after you have been revered, honored and respected by people for many years, to have to face the truth. This is harsh.

Therefore, I don't expect these people to simply accept this. Let me tell you why. Because of that phrase directly. Look, after being a professor of theology... for 40 years at a seminary, teaching thousands of students, suddenly you discover that you were wrong. You cannot change overnight, unless you are like Nicodemus, who possessed wisdom. Even if you have to sneak out at night, for God's sake, face reality. It's harsh. So, because of the time factor, what they usually do is try to attack you.

Of course, they cannot succeed, because you cannot argue with the Bible. So, they try to tarnish your reputation in some way, but it doesn't work. I believe the worst thing in the world is self-denial. As you know, not being honest with yourself. I see this happening. Have you ever heard people say this before? Yes, I know that's true, but man, I grew up that way. Yes, I know that's true, but I was a Baptist. Yes, I know that's true, but I was a Catholic. Yes, I know that's true, but I was a Seventh-day Adventist.

I know that's true, but what are you trying to tell me? You tell me, " Yes, God is right, but I have something that takes priority over God right now." Because I cannot change, I do everything they tell me to. Nicodemus was a clever man, my friend. Nicodemus, as you know, was an old man. Jesus was thirty years old when Nicky met him. Nicky heard Jesus preaching about the Kingdom. Nicky said, "I'm wrong." So, he slipped away from the Sanhedrin complex.

He went at two in the morning, while everyone was asleep, and knocked on the door. Jesus said, "Yes." He said, "Sir, I am a religious man." I am the patron of the complex in this city, and I don't know what I'm talking about. How do I enter the Kingdom? He said. I am already in religion. Tell me how to enter the kingdom of God? Jesus said, "Nicky, it's not that difficult. You must be born again." However, Nicky didn't understand, did he? He said, "Do I have to go back into my mother's womb?"

Jesus said, "My God, you have a doctorate and you can't understand what I mean by that." He's a Doctor of Law. These people you think are smart, you'd be amazed at them. How could he think that Jesus meant it after all those years of study? Jesus said, "No, no, no, you don't go back into your mother's womb." "You must be born with a new spirit." "You must receive enlightenment." He says, "Otherwise, if this does not happen, you cannot understand"—that is what the word "see" means—"the kingdom of God."

He said, " You must receive revelation from the Spirit of God to understand the government of God." Nicodemus wasted a lot of time. But at least he was honest about spending the rest of his time setting the right priorities. Is anyone willing to change their priorities? Look, I've made my decision. That's it. It's too late for me. I'm going to stay with Jesus. Fourth, the right priority protects your energy. When you're doing the right thing, you don't have to worry about wasting your energy anymore.

That's what makes you angry, when you work so hard on something you weren't supposed to do and realize you've wasted all your energy. Imagine how much money they spend on seminaries, robes, turbans, and crosses. You know, all that formality. I mean, think about it. That's a lot of energy. You build buildings, you furnish classrooms and offices, and you think about it and say, "Yes, all the buildings, lessons, resources, and furniture were right, but the lesson was wrong."
